# River Landings Animal Clinic

> A Bradenton, Florida-based veterinary clinic providing comprehensive pet health education, treatment guides, and preventive care information for dogs and cats.

River Landings Animal Clinic serves the Bradenton area with expert veterinary guidance covering common pet health conditions, FDA-approved medications like Solensia and Librela, emergency care protocols, and preventive wellness practices. The clinic maintains an active educational blog addressing pet owners' most pressing health and safety concerns.

## Pet Health & Medical Emergencies

- [Urinary Obstruction and Bladder Stones in Pets](http://www.riverlandingsanimalclinic.com/news/urinary-obstruction-bladder-stones-in-pets): Life-threatening veterinary emergency: urinary obstruction and bladder stones
- [Acute Pancreatitis in Dogs](http://www.riverlandingsanimalclinic.com/news/acute-pancreatitis-in-dogs): Symptoms, diagnosis, and treatment of acute pancreatitis in dogs
- [Cannabis (Marijuana) Intoxication in Cats and Dogs](http://www.riverlandingsanimalclinic.com/news/marijuana-intoxication-in-cats-and-dogs): Guide on cannabis toxicity, THC effects, and treatment for pets

## Dermatology & Skin Conditions

- [Feline Skin Diseases: When is licking more than just grooming?](http://www.riverlandingsanimalclinic.com/news/feline-skin-diseases): Guide to feline skin diseases, parasites, allergies, and dermatology
- [Diagnosing Odor in Cats](http://www.riverlandingsanimalclinic.com/news/diagnosing-odor-in-cats): Guide to feline skin infections, bacterial dermatitis, and yeast causes
- [Why is my dog licking so much that a sore spot forms?](http://www.riverlandingsanimalclinic.com/news/why-is-my-dog-licking-so-much-that-a-sore-spot-forms): Lick granulomas and acral lick dermatitis: causes and treatment
- [Dealing With a Shedding Dog & Shedding Season](http://www.riverlandingsanimalclinic.com/news/dealing-with-a-shedding-dog-seasonal-shedding): Guide to dog shedding, coat care, grooming, and breed-specific tips

## Pain Management & Chronic Conditions

- [Solensia: FDA-Approved Osteoarthritis Treatment for Cats](http://www.riverlandingsanimalclinic.com/news/solensia-the-first-and-only-fda-approved-treatment-to-control-osteoarthritis-pain-in-cats): Solensia injection details for feline osteoarthritis pain management
- [From The Desk of Dr. Fox: It's Allergy Season](http://www.riverlandingsanimalclinic.com/news/dr-fox-its-allergy-season): Dr. Fox's advice on seasonal allergies, itching, and allergy treatment

## Preventive Care & Wellness

- [What does fecal testing tell us about your pet's health?](http://www.riverlandingsanimalclinic.com/news/what-does-fecal-testing-tells-us-about-your-pets-health): Fecal testing for intestinal parasites and preventive pet health care
- [Why You Should Routinely Clean Your Pet's Food and Water Bowls](http://www.riverlandingsanimalclinic.com/news/why-you-should-routinely-clean-your-pets-food-and-water-bowls): Pet hygiene and food safety: preventing salmonella and zoonotic diseases
- [Canine Dental Health: Top 10 Questions and Answers](http://www.riverlandingsanimalclinic.com/news/canine-dental-health-top-10-questions-and-answers): FAQ on dog dental health, teeth care, and dental myths
